Talent0_2Ability.name: Trauma Profiling
Talent0_2Ability.SpecificEffects: When actively attacking with a Light Rifle, inflicts different <buf ID=900137>[Battle Wound]</buf> based on the part hit, lasting for <color=#F74848>2</color>turns. When inflicting <buf ID=900137>[Battle Wound]</buf> with an active attack, triggers <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf>, allowing movement of <color=#F74848>2</color> tiles. This effect can trigger <color=#F74848>1</color> times per turn.

Talent3_5Ability.SpecificEffects:
When actively attacking with a Light Rifle, inflicts different <buf ID=900137>[Battle Wound]</buf> based on the part hit, lasting for <color=#F74848>2</color>turns. When inflicting <buf ID=900137>[Battle Wound]</buf> with an active attack, triggers <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf>, allowing movement of <color=#F74848>2</color> tiles. 300001.name: Sniper Warfare 1
300001.SpecificEffects: When destroying a target, <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> can be triggered, effective up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn. Unable to move before attacking.

700048.name: Sabotage
700048.SpecificEffects: During an Active Attack, deals an additional <color=#F74848>20%</color> DMG to the part with HP below <color=#F74848>50%</color>.

301203.name: Evidence Collection
301203.describe: Chooses <color=#F74848>1</color> enemy within <range type=0>4-tile diamond</range> area, inflicts <color=#F74848>1</color> <buf ID=900137>[Battle Wound]</buf> according to the lowest HP part. Can continue to act without moving.

301204.name: Distress Recovery
301204.SpecificEffects: When initiating combat and destroying a part carrying <buf ID=900137>[Battle Wound]</buf>, restores all AP consumed by the skill, up to the maximum of <color=#F74848>3</color> AP. This effect can trigger <color=#F74848>1</color> times per turn.

301205.name: Remote Analysis
301205.SpecificEffects: When actively attacking, for each <color=#F74848>1</color> tile away from the target, hit rate increases by <color=#F74848>4%</color>, up to <color=#F74848>20%</color>.

301206.name: Full Evaluation
301206.describe: Attacks a target with Light Rifle, dealing <color=#F74848>1.5x</color> DMG. Enters <buf ID=900014>[Aiming]</buf> Mode before attacking. After combat, applies all <buf ID=900137>[Battle Wound]</buf> debuffs to the target, lasting for <color=#F74848>2</color> turns.

301207.name: Deep Insights
301207.SpecificEffects: For each <color=#F74848>1</color> <buf ID=900137>[Battle Wound]</buf> on the field, increases critical damage by <color=#F74848>4%</color>, up to <color=#F74848>20%</color>.

301208.name: Multi-Phase Plan
301208.describe: Attacks a target with Light Rifle, dealing <color=#F74848>0.7x</color> DMG. Selects <color=#F74848>2</color> additional target to deal <color=#F74848>0.7x</color> each. Enters <buf ID=900014>[Aiming]</buf> Mode before attacking. Can select the same target multiple times. Only the first target will counter attack.

300011.name: Sniper Warfare 2
300011.SpecificEffects: After breaking a part, trigger <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf>.

300021.name: Sniper Warfare 3
300021.SpecificEffects: Upon triggering <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf>, allows movement of <color=#F74848>2</color> tiles before attacking.

300022.name: Power Innovation 2
300022.SpecificEffects: When breaking a part, restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

301231.name: Hunting Mark 1
301231.SpecificEffects: When actively attacking and breaking parts with a ranged weapon, gains <buf ID=900141>[Hunting]</buf> according to the part hit. Can trigger <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

301234.name: Hunting Mark 2
301234.SpecificEffects: After actively attacking and destroying a target with a ranged weapon, can additionally move <color=#F74848>3</color> tiles.

301235.name: Hunting Mark 3
301235.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900142>[Hunting Mark 1]</buf> no longer has trigger limit

301236.name: Hunting Mark 4
301236.SpecificEffects: At the start of action, randomly gains <color=#F74848>1</color> of unobtained <buf ID=900141>[Hunting]</buf> buffs.

301241.name: Unveiling 1
301241.SpecificEffects: After initiating combat, if the target is inflicted with <buf ID=900137>[Battle Wound]</buf>, triggers <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf>. Can move <color=#F74848>2</color> tiles before attacking. Can trigger <color=#F74848>1</color> times per turn.

300043.name: Power Innovation 3
300043.SpecificEffects: When destroying a target, additionally restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat, effective up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

301244.name: Unveiling 2
301244.SpecificEffects: Each time talent is triggered, applies <buf ID=900137>[Battle Wound]</buf> to enemies of the same type within <color=#F74848>1</color> ring of the target.

301245.name: Unveiling 3
301245.SpecificEffects: When attacking target carrying <buf ID=900137>[Battle Wound]</buf>, Final DMG dealt is increased by <color=#F74848>5%</color>, with an additional <color=#F74848>5%</color> for each <color=#F74848>1</color> additional stack of <buf ID=900137>[Battle Wound]</buf>, up to<color=#F74848>15%</color>.

301246.name: Unveiling 4
301246.SpecificEffects: Talent <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> effect changes to <buf ID=900005>[Re-Act]</buf>.

hiddenSkills.name: Injury Assessment
hiddenSkills.describe: Attacks a target with Light Rifle, dealing <color=#F74848>1.25x</color> DMG. If there are no allies within <color=#F74848>2</color> adjacent tiles of this unit, can enter <buf ID=900014>[Aiming]</buf> Mode before attacking.
